Jobs und Karriere

Metallbauerinnen und Metallbauer fertigen und montieren verschiedene Metallteile für Gebäude. Dazu gehören zum Beispiel Fassaden, Metallgerüste, Fenster, Türen, Geländer, Treppen oder Zäune. Sie stellen die Teile entweder aus vorgefertigten Profilen oder nach Mass in der Werkstatt her, transportieren sie zur Baustelle und montieren sie vor Ort. Ausserdem reparieren und ersetzen sie beschädigte Metallkonstruktionen.

Und das Beste: Du kannst all das bei den Zermatt Bergbahnen lernen und umsetzen!

Apprenticeship of metalworker/EFZ

breadcrumbs.home

About us

Jobs and careers

Metalworkers manufacture and assemble various metal parts for buildings. These include, for example, facades, metal scaffolding, windows, doors, railings, stairs or fences. They manufacture the parts either from prefabricated profiles or to measure in the workshop, transport them to the construction site and assemble them on site. They also repair and replace damaged metal structures.

And best of all: you can learn and implement all this at the Zermatt Bergbahnen!

Apply now

Start date

Summer 2027

30.09.2026

Application deadline

4 years

Teaching duration

Team

This is what we offer you

Your career with us

Learning content

• Planning and organising work

• Manufacture of metal structures and objects

• Post-processing of metal structures and objects

• Assembly of metal structures and objects

• Maintenance of metal structures and objects

Professional maturity

In the case of very good academic achievements, the vocational school can be attended during basic education.

You should bring this

• You have a particular interest in mathematics and physics.

• Precise and exact work is yours and you have an eye for detail.

• Joy of working metal

• Technical understanding

• You have good spatial imagination.

• You are a young person who likes to work in a team.

Sur nous

Emplois et carrières

Les métallurgistes fabriquent et assemblent diverses pièces métalliques pour les bâtiments. Il s'agit par exemple de façades, d'échafaudages métalliques, de fenêtres, de portes, de rampes, d'escaliers ou de clôtures. Ils fabriquent les pièces à partir de profils préfabriqués ou pour mesurer dans l'atelier, les transportent sur le chantier et les assemblent sur place. Ils réparent et remplacent également les structures métalliques endommagées.

Et surtout : vous pouvez apprendre et mettre en œuvre tout cela au Bergbahnen de Zermatt !

Informazioni su di noi

Lavoro e carriera

Gli aspiranti polimeccanici di Zermatt Bergbahnen svolgono un ruolo chiave nella produzione di utensili, componenti e impianti di produzione da una vasta gamma di materiali. I suoi compiti centrali includono la precisa implementazione dei disegni di progettazione, la selezione di strumenti adatti e l'attento monitoraggio del processo produttivo. Attraverso queste attività, i nostri insegnanti contribuiscono in modo significativo alla garanzia della qualità e alla funzionalità fluida delle ferrovie di montagna Zermatt.

Zermatt Bergbahnen AG gestisce l'area escursionistica internazionale e sportiva di Zermatt. Come datore di lavoro moderno, siamo fortemente ancorati a Zermatt e in tutto il Mattertal. 280 dipendenti lavorano insieme ogni giorno per offrire ai nostri ospiti esperienze indimenticabili intorno al Cervino.

Hai obiettivi ambiziosi, sei motivato e vuoi fare il passo giusto per la tua carriera di successo? Allora siete all'indirizzo giusto con noi!

breadcrumbs.home

About us

Jobs and careers

The aspiring polymechanics at Zermatt Bergbahnen play a key role in the production of tools, components and production plants from a wide range of materials. Its central tasks include the precise implementation of design drawings, the selection of suitable tools and the careful monitoring of the production process. Through these activities, our teachers contribute significantly to the quality assurance and smooth functionality of Zermatt mountain railways.

Zermatt Bergbahnen AG operates Zermatt’s year-round, international excursion and snow sports area. As a modern employer, we are strongly anchored in Zermatt and throughout the Mattertal. 280 employees work together every day to offer our guests unforgettable experiences around the Matterhorn.

You have ambitious goals, are motivated and want to take the right step for your successful career? Then you are at the right address with us!

Apply now

Your career with us

• You manufacture tools and spare parts for all areas of ZBAG. So our slopes and gondolas drive with your help perfectly

• You create technical drawings, 3D models and plans with the CAD program

• You repair parts of systems (e.g. rolls of the commuter paths) and thus ensure safe and smooth railway operation

• You develop production solutions for the production of important spare parts for our plants

• Computer-controlled machine programming

• Installation services of equipment

• You do various work such as drilling, milling, grinding, measuring and controlling

Die angehenden Polymechaniker/innen bei den Zermatt Bergbahnen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle in der Herstellung von Werkzeugen, Bauteilen und Produktionsanlagen aus vielfältigen Materialien. Ihre zentralen Aufgaben umfassen die präzise Umsetzung von Konstruktionszeichnungen, die Auswahl der passenden Werkzeuge und die sorgfältige Überwachung des Produktionsprozesses. Durch diese Tätigkeiten tragen unsere Lehrnenden massgeblich zur Qualitätssicherung und reibungslosen Funktionalität der Zermatt Bergbahnen bei.

Die Zermatt Bergbahnen AG betreibt das ganzjährige, internationale Ausflugs- und Schneesportgebiet von Zermatt. Als moderner Arbeitgeber sind wir in Zermatt und im gesamten Mattertal stark verankert. 280 Mitarbeitende setzen sich tagtäglich gemeinsam dafür ein, unseren Gästen unvergessliche Erlebnisse rund ums Matterhorn zu bieten.

À propos de nous

Emplois et carrières

Zermatt Bergbahnen AG exploite toute l'année le domaine international d'excursions et de sports de neige de Zermatt. En tant qu'employeur moderne, nous sommes fortement ancrés à Zermatt et dans tout le Mattertal. 280 collaborateurs travaillent ensemble chaque jour pour offrir à nos clients des expériences inoubliables autour du Cervin. Nous recherchons des téléphériques expérimentés, autonomes et aimant travailler avec des gens pour des gens.
